theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market Swings Are Not Permanent Losses
body: Volatility is normal. Panic selling locks in losses. Staying invested through cycles historically builds wealth.
caption: Markets fluctuate daily, but short-term dips don't mean permanent value loss. Emotional decisions during downturns often hurt long-term goals. Patience through cycles has historically rewarded investors. #BehaviouralFinance #StayInvested #MarketVolatility #LongTermWealth #InvestorMindset
